welcome.title: Thank you for installing KCP: Course Planner for KMITL
welcome.body: Plan your timetable before registration from the courses offered on this site. Saved plans stay in this browser only.
welcome.step.search.body: Search by curriculum and class year, subject id, or subject category.
welcome.step.add.body: Clashing class times and exam times are flagged as you place them.
welcome.step.suggest.body: Tick the subjects you want and get timetables whose times do not clash.
welcome.access.shortcut: Open it any time from the Planner button at the bottom right, the extension icon, or the shortcut {shortcut}.
welcome.access: Open it any time from the Planner button at the bottom right or the extension icon.
entryToast.noPlan: Use Planner to plan your timetable from the courses offered on this site.
entryToast.route: Open this search in Planner to place its sections on a timetable.
coachMark.announce: Planner is at the lower right of the screen. Use it to plan your timetable from the courses you search on this page.
tour.search.title: Search for courses
tour.search.body: Search by curriculum and class year, by subject ID, or by subject category. Pick how to search here.
tour.search.bodyChip: Your current search shows here. Press it to change the search.
tour.add.title: Add a section to the timetable
tour.add.body: Press the plus button on a section to add it to your timetable. The planner tells you when class or exam times clash.
tour.add.bodyCourse: Press a course to see its sections, then press the plus button on the section you want.
tour.add.bodyFields: Sections show after you search with these fields. Then press a course, and the plus button on a section adds it to your timetable.
tour.timetable.title: Read your timetable
tour.timetable.body: The timetable shows the classes you placed across the week. Press a class to see its details.
tour.timetable.bodyDays: Pick the whole week or one day at a time from this row. Press a class to see its details.
tour.suggest.title: Suggest a plan
tour.suggest.body: After a search by curriculum, press here and the planner builds timetables whose times do not clash.
tour.export.title: Export your timetable
tour.export.body: Save the timetable as an image or copy it as text to share.
tour.ended: You can open the tour again from the More options menu.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.undo: Undo the last change to the plan while its undo message shows
shortcuts.escape: Close the open window, leave the export page, or close the panel
shortcuts.note: Shortcuts do not apply while you type in a field.
regis.title: Registration helper
regis.prepareIntro: KCP reads every section of the subjects in this plan once and keeps them in your browser, so nothing needs to load on registration day. Prepare at a quiet time. The data stays usable for 7 days.
regis.prepareRefused: Preparing is not available on the registration pages while the system takes registrations. Open the course search page and prepare there.
regis.prepareCancelled: Preparing stopped. The earlier data is kept.
regis.prepareFailed: The data could not be read. Try again later.
regis.kitStale: The section data is older than 7 days. Prepare again at a quiet time.
regis.noPlan: This plan has no subjects yet
regis.noPlanBody: Choose subjects in the planner first, and they will be listed here.
regis.saveBlocked: This section cannot be saved to the plan because it clashes with another subject.
regis.banner: The registration page has {listed} of the {total} planned subjects. Check before you confirm.
regis.fill.stop.notReady: Open the choose subjects step first, then press Add for me again.
regis.fill.stop.termMismatch: This page is for another term than the plan. Change the plan first.
regis.fill.stop.dialogOpen: Close the open window on the page, then press Add for me again.
regis.fill.stop.fieldNotEmpty: Clear the subject id field with the trash icon, then press Add for me again.
regis.fill.stop.listedOther: The page already lists another section of this subject. Remove it on the page if unwanted, then press Add for me again.
regis.fill.stop.refused: The page does not offer this section to you. Read the page message and pick another section.
regis.fill.stop.notOffered: The page does not offer this section to you. Pick another section.
regis.fill.stop.notVisible: KCP cannot see this section in the list. Pick it on the page, then press Add for me again.
regis.fill.stop.practiceMissing: The page does not offer this practice section. Pick another section.
regis.fill.stop.practiceUnplanned: The page would add a practice section the plan does not hold, so KCP does not press Add. Check the page and press Add yourself.
regis.fill.stop.duplicateCode: This section has more than one curriculum. Pick yours on the page, then press Add for me again.
regis.fill.stop.full: More students applied than there are seats; results come later. Press Add for me to keep this section, or pick another.
regis.fill.stop.hostClash: The page reports a class or exam clash. Pick another section.
regis.fill.stop.kcpClash: This section clashes with a subject on the list, although the page does not say so. Pick another section.
regis.fill.stop.listUnknown: KCP cannot check a subject on the page list for clashes. You can enter the list yourself.
regis.fill.stop.credits: The credits would exceed what this page allows. Remove a subject from the plan first.
regis.fill.stop.noAnswer: The page is still waiting for the server, and KCP resent nothing. Press Add for me again once it shows the sections.
regis.fill.stop.pageChanged: The page changed while adding. Check it, then press Add for me again.
regis.fill.stop.untestedBuild: The registration page has been updated and KCP has not been tested with it yet. You can enter the list yourself.
regis.fill.stop.latched: KCP turned Add for me off for this page version because it met a button it must not press. You can enter the list yourself.
regis.fill.stop.notRecognised: KCP cannot read this page right now. You can enter the list yourself.
regis.fill.stop.noKit: Prepare the plan first to use Add for me.
regis.addForMe.unavailable: Add for me is not available yet
regis.addForMe.onlyInStep: Available in the choose subjects step
regis.hidden: Hidden until you open this page again
